commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Odin’s Glasses fantasy inventory illustration, square. Use image 1 only to identify the game item's recognizable object, main colors and silhouette; image 2 is our existing illustration STYLE reference. Redesign details and rendering into our own polished hand-painted fantasy style with soft cel shading, warm brown contours, gentle highlights. Center the complete single item, large readable silhouette at 128px, with generous 10% margin. Uniform warm ivory background #fffaf1 and a small soft contact shadow. No person, text, letters, logo, watermark, frame, collage, pixel art, or copied sprite pixels. Subject:
